tagline: World leader in sustainable aviation fuel and renewable diesel, driving the circular economy
hero_kpi_rationale: Neste is the global leader in sustainable aviation fuel and renewable diesel, with a direct climate impact of 12.1 MtCO2e avoided in 2024, demonstrating clear differentiation in the circular economy

kpis.name: Revenue
kpis.explanation: Total sales generated by the company during the year.
kpis.description: Revenue decreased compared to 2023, falling from 22.9 billion to 20.6 billion euros.

kpis.name: Comparable EBITDA
kpis.explanation: Adjusted operating profit before exceptional items.
kpis.description: Comparable EBITDA sharply declined in 2024 to 1.252 billion EUR, reflecting margin pressures in renewable activities due to intensified competition and lower pricing.

kpis.name: Leverage Ratio
kpis.explanation: Net debt to Comparable EBITDA ratio, measuring debt repayment capacity.
kpis.description: The leverage ratio increased to 36.1% in 2024, up from 22.7% in 2023, but remains below the 40% target and maintains an investment grade credit rating.
kpis.signal: Increased relative leverage due to lower EBITDA

kpis.name: Average Headcount
kpis.explanation: Average number of employees during the year.
kpis.description: Average headcount was 5,796 in 2024, indicating stable workforce levels despite business pressures.

kpis.name: GHG Emission Reduction
kpis.explanation: Amount of greenhouse gas emissions avoided through Neste's renewable products.
kpis.description: Neste's renewable and circular products avoided 12.1 million tons of CO2 equivalent in 2024, reflecting the direct impact of the energy transition.

kpis.name: Proposed Dividend per Share
kpis.explanation: Proposed dividend amount per share for 2025.
kpis.description: A dividend of 0.20 EUR per share is proposed for 2025, reflecting a cautious approach amid declining profitability and market uncertainties.
kpis.signal: Maintenance of a conservative dividend despite lower performance

kpis.name: Total Assets
kpis.description: Total assets extracted from yfinance over the last four years.
kpis.signal: Total assets of 15.75 Bn EUR in the latest year

kpis.name: Total Debt
kpis.description: Total debt extracted from yfinance over the last four years.
kpis.signal: Total debt of 5.18 Bn EUR in the latest year

kpis.name: Dividend per Share
kpis.description: Annual dividend per share paid, aggregated from yfinance.dividends over the last seven fiscal years reported by the company.
kpis.signal: Dividend per share of 0.2 EUR in the latest year.

kpis.name: Capital Returned (dividends)
kpis.description: Capital returned to shareholders via annual dividends, extracted from yfinance.cashflow over the last four reported fiscal years.
kpis.signal: Capital returned to shareholders via dividends of 0.154 Bn EUR in the latest year.

kpis.name: Payout Ratio
kpis.description: Payout Ratio = Dividends Paid / Net Income, calculated over the last three fiscal years from yfinance.cashflow and yfinance.income_stmt.
kpis.signal: Share of net income distributed as dividends: 106.9% in the latest year.

risks.title: Economic slowdown and demand
risks.score_rationale: Risk positioned early in the section (strong position), moderate language ('could have an indirect impact'), stable but persistent trend (continued weak growth), macro category weighted normally.

risks.title: Geopolitical tensions and trade restrictions
risks.score_rationale: Risk explicitly named with strong language ('material adverse effect'), positioned mid-report, increasing trend (Ukraine war, Middle East tensions listed), geopolitical category heavily weighted for energy sector.

risks.title: Regulatory developments and fragmentation
risks.score_rationale: Risk positioned mid-report with moderate but explicit language ('create uncertainties'), stable but chronic trend (ongoing regulatory fragmentation), regulation category heavily weighted for fuel sector.

risks.title: Technological competition and rival capacity
risks.score_rationale: Risk positioned mid-report with strong language ('may decrease demand and lower margins'), increasing trend (new entrants, competing technology development), technology category heavily weighted for competitive advantage.

risks.title: Operational risks and business continuity
risks.score_rationale: Risk positioned mid-report with very strong language ('material adverse effect'), stable but critical trend (reliance on three refineries), industrial category heavily weighted for refining sector.

risks.title: Refining margin volatility
risks.score_rationale: Risk positioned mid-report with moderate language but recognition of historical volatility, stable trend (persistent volatility), macro category weighted normally but with direct impact on financial results.

risks.title: Regulatory compliance and reputational risks
risks.score_rationale: Risk positioned mid-report with moderate language ('adverse financial and reputational impact'), increasing trend (growing supply chain fragmentation), regulation category heavily weighted.

risks.title: Cybersecurity and critical IT systems
risks.score_rationale: Risk positioned at the end of the report with very strong language ('could significantly impact business operations, profitability, and reputation'), increasing trend (growing sophisticated threats), cybersecurity category heavily weighted.
